$comment: Declared vault sources for the retrieval layer. Roots are ~-relative (expanded by
build.mjs at the one place this file is read) so the committed file names no absolute
home directory; the built index is derived and .vault/ is gitignored.
graphify owns the CODE graph (AST, free). This owns the DOCUMENT graph, where graphify's
free path extracts nothing and its document path would need LLM extraction. The edges here
are hand-authored [[wikilinks]], read rather than inferred, at zero token cost.
